mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen 4.8 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w despite persistent workplace suppression. This sustained upward trend in retail mobility, independent of workplace recovery, indicates autonomous consumer demand that will continue lifting retail footfall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -9.7% to -4.9% over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the prior 28 days, or reverses by more than 3 percentage points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has risen consistently from 4.3% to 7.3% over four weeks, signaling increased essential-goods shopping trips. Consumers bundling retail-and-recreation visits with grocery runs will drive RETAIL_REC higher as grocery momentum sustains above 6% over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 5.0% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining elevated.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility remains severely suppressed at -46.3%, indicating commuting has not recovered. When TRANSIT falls more than 45 percentage points below baseline, workplace-anchored retail activity (lunch, after-work shopping) is blocked, constraining RETAIL_REC growth to below +2% over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises more than 2 percentage points above its current level while TRANSIT remains below -45%, or TRANSIT recovers above -40% without corresponding RETAIL_REC acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has declined from -17.0% to -14.3%, showing outdoor activity is suppressed. When PARKS remains below -10%, consumers substitute toward indoor retail-and-recreation venues, driving RETAIL_REC positive over the next four weeks as seasonal holiday shopping begins.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -14.3% in t-0w, improving but still suppressed
failure_condition: PARKS recovers above 0% while RETAIL_REC remains negative, or RETAIL_REC declines despite PARKS staying below -10%.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT are both severely suppressed (WORKPLACES -14.7%, TRANSIT -46.3%), yet RETAIL_REC has improved. This decoupling indicates remote-work populations are driving retail demand independently of commuting. If both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain below -14% and -45% respectively, RETAIL_REC will continue rising as non-commuter retail activity dominates over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks, or either WORKPLACES or TRANSIT recovers above their respective thresholds without RETAIL_REC acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined from 6.0% to 4.1%, indicating people are leaving home more frequently. When RESIDENTIAL falls below 5%, it signals reduced lockdown compliance or policy relaxation, enabling RETAIL_REC to rise above -3% over the next four weeks as mobility freedoms expand.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rises above 6.0% while RETAIL_REC remains below -5%, or RETAIL_REC declines despite RESIDENTIAL falling below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC are both improving (GROCERY_PHARM +7.3%, RETAIL_REC -4.9%), indicating a synchronized recovery in consumer mobility across essential and discretionary categories. When both rise together, the interaction amplifies foot traffic in mixed-use venues, driving RETAIL_REC above -2% over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM above 6.5% AND RETAIL_REC improving week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines in the next week despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining above 6.5%, or the week-on-week improvement in RETAIL_REC reverses.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT suppression at -46.3% combined with WORKPLACES suppression at -14.7% creates a regime where commute-based retail activity is blocked. However, RESIDENTIAL decline to 4.1% indicates non-commuters are mobile. This regime-specific interaction predicts RETAIL_REC will remain below -3% over the next four weeks because commuter-anchored retail cannot compensate for suppressed transit.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below -45% AND WORKPLACES below -15% AND RESIDENTIAL below 5%
evidence_refs: fact:All three conditions met in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above 0% over the next 28 days while all three proxies remain in their suppressed regime, or TRANSIT recovers above -40% without corresponding RETAIL_REC acceleration.
